title: The Lord’s Jewels
old_p1: In Malachi’s day, some people loved and honored the Lord. They often talked together, and they thought about Him.
The Lord listened, and He heard them. A book of remembrance was written for them. A book of remembrance is a book that helps us remember.
Long ago, Adam’s family kept a book of remembrance too.
old_p2: The Lord said, “They shall be mine … my jewels.” Jewels are bright, precious stones that a king keeps safe. The Lord was saying His people are precious to Him.
You are precious to the Lord too. Tonight, think of one thing you love about Jesus, just like those good people who thought about the Lord.
p1: In Malachi’s day, many people forgot the Lord. But some loved Him. They talked together often, and they thought about Him.
The Lord listened, and He heard every word.
So a book was written for them. It was called a book of remembrance, so they would always be remembered.
p2: The Lord said, “They shall be mine... my jewels.” Jewels are bright, precious stones that people keep safe. He would keep His people safe too, like a dad keeps his son.
You are precious to the Lord too. Tonight, talk with your family about something you love about Jesus.
